response.text: {"title": "How we would deliver", "text": "We would send the proposal by e-mail to the Trust's office by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12 as one document of no more than 15 pages, keep all personal data in the United Kingdom, and ensure the system is live by 2027-06-30 [APP-001].
